methods.name: Peer-Median

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Sage Geosystems is a Series B climate and energy company founded by Cindy Taff and Lance Cook that has raised $114M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set spanning 1 public company and 8 private firms in the Climate & Energy sector, with particular focus on three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: KoBold Metals ($3.0B Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B Series C), and Amogy ($700M Series C).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $217M. The peer-median method isolates three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, producing a median valuation of $1.0B with a range of $700M to $3.0B. These comparables reflect the venture capital appetite for climate technology at later stages.

The combined analysis supports a valuation range of $184M to $1.1B, with a median point of $608M. The wide spread reflects meaningful uncertainty: peer valuations span nearly a 4x range, and stage-progression relies on capital raised rather than observed market transactions. The median estimate suggests Sage Geosystems likely values between $600M and $700M, though this requires validation against actual Series B pricing data and company-specific metrics not available in the provided dataset.
